+    def test_namespace_declarations_share_exact_attribute_limits(self):
+        def declarations(count):
+            return ' '.join('xmlns:p'+str(i)+'="urn:unused:'+str(i)+'"' for i in range(count))
+        def root_decl(attrs):
+            return sheet().replace(b'<worksheet ', ('<worksheet '+attrs+' ').encode())
+        # Root already declares the default namespace:31 more is the count32 boundary.
+        self.good(package(root_decl(declarations(31))))
+        report=self.bad(package(root_decl(declarations(32))),'LAYOUT_LIMIT')
+        state=report['worksheet_exposure']['References']
+        self.assertTrue(state['worksheet_utf8_decode_completed'])
+        self.assertTrue(state['worksheet_xml_parse_started'])
+        self.assertTrue(state['worksheet_structure_traversal_started'])
+        self.assertFalse(state['worksheet_structure_traversal_completed'])
+        self.assertFalse(state['worksheet_xml_parse_completed'])
+        self.good(package(root_decl('xmlns:unused="'+('u'*1024)+'"')))
+        self.bad(package(root_decl('xmlns:unused="'+('u'*1025)+'"')),'LAYOUT_LIMIT')
+        self.good(package(root_decl('xmlns:'+('p'*250)+'="urn:unused"')))
+        self.bad(package(root_decl('xmlns:'+('p'*251)+'="urn:unused"')),'LAYOUT_LIMIT')
+        # Two ordinary attributes r/s plus30 namespace declarations are exactly32.
+        for count in (30,31):
+            content='<sheetData><row r="1"><c r="A1" s="uninterpreted" '+declarations(count)+'/></row></sheetData>'
+            if count==30:self.good(package(sheet(content)))
+            else:self.bad(package(sheet(content)),'LAYOUT_LIMIT')
+        # Per-element namespace declaration counters reset; inherited bindings do not recount.
+        content='<sheetData><row r="1">'+''.join('<c r="'+letter+'1" '+declarations(31)+'/>' for letter in ('A','B'))+'</row></sheetData>'
+        self.good(package(sheet(content)))
+        # Allowing an unused namespace never permits using its foreign expanded nodes/attrs.
+        self.bad(package(sheet('<sheetData xmlns:f="urn:foreign"><f:row r="1"/></sheetData>')),'WORKSHEET_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED')
+        self.bad(package(sheet('<sheetData xmlns:f="urn:foreign"><row r="1" f:r="1"/></sheetData>')),'WORKSHEET_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED')
+
